capabilities.name: Capability Search
capabilities.description: Find the best external tool, API, MCP server, or machine service for a goal.

capabilities.name: MCP Probe
capabilities.description: Verify a remote MCP endpoint is alive and inspect compatibility, latency, server metadata, and tool inventory before connecting.

capabilities.name: Agent Readiness Audit
capabilities.description: Audit a public website for agent discoverability, llms.txt, ARD, OpenAPI, sitemap, MCP metadata, and baseline headers.

capabilities.name: Web Extract
capabilities.description: Turn a public webpage into clean structured text or JSON.

capabilities.name: JavaScript Render
capabilities.description: Render a JavaScript-heavy webpage and return machine-readable content.

capabilities.name: PDF Parse
capabilities.description: Extract structured text, tables, and metadata from a PDF.

capabilities.name: Vendor Check
capabilities.description: Assess a domain or vendor for basic legitimacy and risk signals.

capabilities.name: Wallet Risk
capabilities.description: Analyze an EVM or Tron wallet and return a machine-readable risk verdict.
